portalSwitch.confirmBody_one: {{name}} disappears from the portal for {{count}} active client user. Open pages stop loading on their next request. Nothing is deleted, and you can turn it back on at any time.
portalSwitch.confirmBody_other: {{name}} disappears from the portal for {{count}} active client users. Open pages stop loading on their next request. Nothing is deleted, and you can turn it back on at any time.
portalSwitch.confirmBody_zero: {{name}} disappears from the portal. No client users are signed in to it right now. Nothing is deleted, and you can turn it back on at any time.

portalSwitch.turnedOff: Client access to {{name}} was revoked immediately.
portalSwitch.turnedOn: Client Portal is on for {{name}}. Assigned client users can now see it.

roleAdminDescription: Views assigned projects, comments, uploads permitted files, submits change requests, approves items and can manage client users if enabled.
roleMemberDescription: Views assigned projects, comments, uploads permitted files and submits change requests. Cannot approve or manage users.
roleViewerDescription: Read-only: project information, milestones, client-visible tasks and files. Cannot comment, upload, approve or submit change requests.

visibilityToast.sharedFile: “{{name}}” is now shared with the client. Client users on the project are notified.
visibilityToast.sharedMilestone: “{{name}}” is now visible to the client.
visibilityToast.sharedTask: “{{name}}” is now visible to the client.
visibilityToast.withdrawn: “{{name}}” is now Internal Only. Client access is removed immediately.

signInLinkDescription: Opening this link emails a 6-digit code to {{email}}, and entering it signs them in. There is no password. The link works for 7 days and replaces any earlier link.
userDeletedHint: Deleted by the user on {{deleted}}. It can be restored until {{until}}.
